capabilities: Create ordered or unordered lists with task state directives (:to-do, :doing, :paused, :done)
Render directives as interactive task state boxes
Sort list items by status via command or context menus
Cycle or set task states by clicking state boxes
extras: Author asks for sponsorships; README includes a project emphasis on performance and Markdown compatibility so documents stay readable outside the plugin.
intentEvidence: A simple obsidian plugin enabling better task management via lists.
problem: Obsidian's task lists only offer a checkbox, with no way to track intermediate states or sort list items by task status.
summary: Task list plugin that adds state directives (:to-do, :doing, :paused, :done) to Markdown list items, rendering clickable state boxes with sorting.
